thread:
Asha Patel (Hiring Manager): Heads-up: need to close on Priyanka Mehta (Director, Platform PM) today. Candidate has another firm at +20% total comp and wants to start 10 days earlier than our earliest window. Can we do a one-time comp uplift + sign-on split and expedite approvals?
Noah Reed - People Ops: Details pls: current band, proposed base/total, relocation? any visa?
Asha Patel (Hiring Manager): Band = Band 8 D1, midpoint $180k base. Proposed offer: base $195k + $50k sign-on (split 60% at start / 40% at 4 months) = $245k total. Start requested 2026-06-01; our earliest is 2026-06-11. Candidate needs short-term relocation stipend for first month. No visa.
Samira Khan (Recruiter): Candidate wants written offer today. Recruiter deadline EOD PT. She's sensitive to timeline.
Ellen Park (Comp Committee): Uplift math = ~8% base uplift, sign-on is material. Per policy, >7% base uplift requires comp committee review; sign-on >$25k flagged. I'll join the expedited review.
Noah Reed - People Ops: I'll trigger approvals flow as expedited. Routing: comp-committee -> finance -> payroll -> people-ops final. Tagging reviewers.
approvals-bot: Approval request created: ID 0x9c2b. Candidate Priyanka Mehta; Role Director Platform PM; Proposed base $195k + $50k sign-on (60/40); Early start 2026-06-01; relocation stipend requested; Expedited. Due: 2026-05-27 16:00 PT. Link: https://approvals.internal/0x9c2b
Marco Diaz (Finance): Quick ask: headcount code and FY allocation? Is relocation stipend capitalized? Also need justification for 60/40 split (higher frontload increases immediate cash impact).
Asha Patel (Hiring Manager): Headcount: PM-PLAT-2026-09. Budget owner = Rajesh Nair (Eng Finance). Rationale: strategic hire for infra migration; high replacement cost; candidate countered with sign-on demand. Split is frontloaded to secure acceptance.
Noah Reed - People Ops: @Asha we'll need Rajesh's verbal or written ack, and the hiring manager's manager sign-off for early start. Also need relocation stipend amount and housing plan.
Asha Patel (Hiring Manager): Relocation stipend = $5k for temporary housing. I've pinged Rajesh and my manager (Diane Chu) for sign-off.
Ellen Park (Comp Committee): Comp committee provisional APPROVE — condition: finance + Rajesh ack and payroll confirms split schedule and clawback language. Document candidate-specific rationale in Greenhouse.
Marco Diaz (Finance): Rajesh confirmed budget via DM and ok to fund relocation. Finance approves one-time sign-on and stipend provided payroll confirms payable schedule and tax treatment.
approvals-bot: Approval update: comp-committee APPROVED by Ellen Park; finance APPROVED by Marco Diaz; payroll PENDING.
Noah Reed - People Ops: Samira 12: payroll will need candidate SSN + bank details and signed offer language for split + clawback. Can you gather and upload? Also need Diane Chu manager approval pasted here for early start.
Samira Khan (Recruiter): Uploading candidate SSN form and bank ACH in secure folder now. Diane Chu DM'ed: "Approve early start and the stipend. Ensure onboarding coverage and mentor assigned." Pasted approval.
Noah Reed - People Ops: Good. Payroll: please confirm dates for 60% upfront and 40% at 4 months, with clawback if terminated within 6 months. Also confirm whether stipend will be paid in first paycheck or as a separate reimbursement.
approvals-bot: Payroll request sent to payroll-team.
Payroll-team (system): Payroll note: we can schedule 60% sign-on in first payroll cycle after start; remainder at month-4 cycle. Stipend paid as separate expense reimbursement on first payroll; clawback enforceable via repayment clause. Pending final signed offer.
Noah Reed - People Ops: All approvals in. People Ops to finalize offer language and mark as expedited in approvals UI. Samira, hold until People Ops posts final offer doc.
Samira Khan (Recruiter): Drafted offer and uploaded to approvals. Includes 60/40 sign-on schedule, $5k temporary housing stipend, and 6-month clawback. Sent to candidate via secure link. Candidate accepted verbally; will sign within 24hrs.
Asha Patel (Hiring Manager): Thanks everyone. Once signed I'll coordinate start logistics and buddy assignment. Closing loop here. :tada:
